operations.name: Make Pattern and Cores
operations.setup_note: Prepare the pattern and cores for the specified ductile-iron casting, with machining stock and casting features verified against the approved model.

operations.name: Pour Ductile-Iron Casting
operations.setup_note: Pour the SG450/10 casting from the prepared pattern and cores; the order quantity is 10 parts.

operations.name: Shakeout and Fettle Casting
operations.setup_note: Remove the casting from the mold, remove gates and risers without damaging machining stock, and clear foundry sand from internal passages.

operations.name: Casting Radiographic Examination
operations.setup_note: Examine the fettled casting to the specified level 3 radiographic requirement and retain the inspection record.

operations.name: Clean Before Stress Relief
operations.setup_note: Wash and dry the casting after fettling and radiography before loading it into the stress-relief furnace.

operations.name: Stress Relieve Casting
operations.setup_note: Stress-relieve the clean ductile-iron casting before machining; use the approved casting heat-treatment cycle. This treatment does not change the planned machinability state to hardened.

operations.name: Rough Machine Datum Faces
operations.setup_note: Locate the stress-relieved casting on stable as-cast supports and rough the primary planar datum region. Take the first cut at least 2 mm below cast skin and verify stock distribution before proceeding.

operations.name: Rough Turn Cast Housing
operations.setup_note: Fixture the casting from the roughed datum face and indicate the casting axis. Confirm adequate casting stock on every turned feature before cutting; use dust extraction for cast-iron machining.

operations.name: Rough Mill Upper Recess
operations.setup_note: Locate from the roughed datum face and support the casting around the upper profile. Rough the recess and its walls before any finish machining.

operations.name: Finish Turn Housing Diameters
operations.setup_note: Re-establish the casting axis from datum A and the roughed cylindrical datums. Finish the turned features after the route's rough cuts are complete; verify the largest diameter against available casting stock.

operations.name: Finish Datum Faces, Recess, and Axial Holes
operations.setup_note: Locate from datum A and the established turned axis, using the drawing datums for hole positioning. Finish the datum and recess surfaces before drilling; ream the dowel holes immediately after drilling without disturbing the setup.

operations.name: Machine Radial Mounting Holes
operations.setup_note: Fixture and index the housing to access the radial mounting-hole locations while retaining datum references. Drill the specified tap holes and tap them last in this setup; confirm blind-hole depths from the drawing before machining.

operations.name: Drill Side Lug Holes
operations.setup_note: Support the casting on datum references and index the fixture to access the side lugs. Spot and drill the four through-holes without clamping distortion of the lugs.

operations.name: Machine Axial Housing Thread
operations.setup_note: Locate the upper boss from the turned axis and machine the specified axial thread. The drawing note calls for assembly machining with a cap; confirm the cap and the missing Ø84 bore definition before releasing this operation.

operations.name: Deburr Machined Part
operations.setup_note: Remove machining burrs and sharp edges, paying particular attention to drilled-hole exits and thread starts while protecting finished datum and fit surfaces.

operations.name: Wash After Machining
operations.setup_note: Clean machining residue and cast-iron dust from the housing before structural testing and final inspection.

operations.name: Structural Test
operations.setup_note: Test the machined housing to CTS3040L and record the required result before coating.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Casting Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect critical dimensions, datum relationships, surface finish, and casting documentation after machining and structural testing. Verify the radiographic and supplier quality records are complete.

operations.name: Mask Machined Surfaces for Primer
operations.setup_note: Mask machined surfaces, bores, and threads that must receive anti-rust oil rather than primer.

operations.name: Final Casting Blast
operations.setup_note: Blast the unmasked interior and exterior casting surfaces as specified, keeping masked machined surfaces protected; transfer directly to primer application.

operations.name: Apply Zinc-Phosphate Primer
operations.setup_note: Immediately apply the specified charcoal-grey zinc-phosphate primer to the blasted interior and exterior casting surfaces.

operations.name: Unmask Machined Surfaces
operations.setup_note: Remove masking after the primer has been applied without damaging the coating or finished machined surfaces.

operations.name: Apply Anti-Rust Oil
operations.setup_note: Apply DW39 or equivalent anti-rust oil to all machined surfaces after primer masking is removed.

clarifications.question: Which feature is the Ø84 +0/-0.012 bore mentioned in the assembly-machining note? The routing view identifies F59 as an Ø84 outside diameter but contains no corresponding Ø84 bore feature.
clarifications.suggested_default: Provide the bore location and geometry from the referenced drawing/model before machining; do not infer it from F59.

clarifications.question: Will the mating cap be supplied so the M90×2 thread and Ø84 bore can be machined as an assembly, as required by the drawing note?
clarifications.suggested_default: Machine as an assembly only if the matching cap is supplied and identified for the job.

clarifications.question: What valid screw engagement or required blind tap depth applies to the four M14×2 mounting holes?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the drawing's specified screw engagement and make tap depth greater than the valid screw depth.

clarifications.question: What is the definition or location of datum DB referenced by the positional tolerances for the hole pattern and dowel hole F70?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use datum DB as defined on the complete drawing/model; do not substitute another datum without approval.

assumptions.text: The ductile-iron casting requires stress relief before machining; the specific furnace cycle is to follow the approved casting specification because no cycle parameters are supplied.

The casting/model provides adequate machining allowance on all specified turned and milled surfaces. Verify stock distribution before committing to datum locations, particularly for the Ø119.7 feature.

The available operation vocabulary has no separate semi-finish machining type. The route therefore rough-machines all turned and recessed features, then proceeds to finish machining after the roughing stages.
The specified radiographic examination and supplier quality records will document casting soundness; no separate destructive fracture or sectioning test sample was specified.
No pressure test is included because the stated requirement is a structural test to CTS3040L, not a pressure test.
